identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Flow State' examination platform that reduces anxiety through calm, focused, and optimistic design.
principles: Fusion: Gamified Stats + Zen Garden Focus
Emotion: Optimism for students, Control for teachers
Content: Data is beautiful, Questions are clear
Contrast: Soft backgrounds vs. Sharp, high-contrast text

headings.usage: All section titles, page headers, and modal titles. DO NOT use Inter for headings.

primary.name: Electric Azure
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, links. (Avoid generic Purple/Teal)

secondary.name: Vibrant Coral
secondary.usage: Call to Actions (Start Exam), Alerts, High Priority.

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode First (Optimistic/Focus). Dark Mode optional but secondary.
colors.gradients: Use subtle mesh gradients for dashboard backgrounds only. NO gradients on buttons.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating timers, modal overlays.

rules: Never fill 100% perfectly; leave breathing room.

exam_interface.sidebar: Sticky right sidebar for Question Navigator & Timer.
exam_interface.main: Clean, distraction-free question area. Large text.

cards.style: Flat white surface, subtle border, soft shadow.

timer.style: Fixed/Sticky position. Monospace font. Changes color (Green -> Orange -> Red) as time depletes.

hero_student.usage: Landing page hero or student dashboard banner

exam_focus.usage: Exam instructions page or 'Get Started' section

teacher_tablet.usage: Teacher dashboard welcome or features section

abstract_bg.usage: Login page background or subtle overlay

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add 'Outfit' and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
2. THEME SETUP: Configure tailwind.config.js with the 'Electric Azure' and 'Vibrant Coral' palette.
3. DASHBOARD: Build the Student Dashboard using the 'Bento Grid' layout. Make it look like a stats screen.
4. EXAM UI: Prioritize the 'Exam Taking Page'. It must be distraction-free. Use a sticky sidebar for the timer and question map.
5. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn for complex logic (Calendars, Dialogs) but style them with the 'Visual Enhancers' rules (Rounded-2xl, Soft Shadows).
6. ANIMATION: Add 'framer-motion' for page transitions and list entrance animations. Make the timer pulse when low.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, question options).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' (generic centered layouts). Use asymmetry.
Dark colors look good independently, NOT as gradients.
Use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md for sticky elements.
